mapper.insert: insert into orders (username, totalprice, ordertime, status) values (#{userName}, #{totalPrice}, #{orderTime}, #{status})

insert into order_items (orderid, pid, pname, pimage, price, quantity) values
(#{orderId}, #{item.pid}, #{item.pname}, #{item.pimage}, #{item.price}, #{item.quantity})
mapper.select: select pid, pname, pimage, price, quantity from order_items where orderid = #{orderId} order by id asc
select orderid as orderId, username as userName, totalprice as totalPrice, ordertime as orderTime, status from orders where username = #{userName} order by ordertime desc
select count(*) from orders where username = #{userName}
select orderid as orderId, username as userName, totalprice as totalPrice, ordertime as orderTime, status from orders order by ordertime desc
select orderid as orderId, username as userName, totalprice as totalPrice, ordertime as orderTime, status from orders order by ordertime desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from orders where status = #{status}
select count(*) from orders where DATE(ordertime) = CURDATE()
select IFNULL(SUM(totalprice), 0) from orders where DATE(ordertime) = CURDATE()
